se},{"paragraph":29,"text":"墨丘利秘典","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":36,"text":"古书","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":39,"text":"古书","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":40,"text":"这本书","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":42,"text":"古书","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":44,"text":"墨丘利秘典","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":44,"text":"星界使者","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":47,"text":"古书","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":49,"text":"小破书","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":51,"text":"古书","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":57,"text":"古书","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":64,"text":"古书","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":73,"text":"墨丘利秘典","occurrence":0,"name":true}]},{"id":"r_grandma","mentions":[{"paragraph":15,"text":"太奶","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":15,"text":"太奶","occurrence":1,"name":true}]},{"id":"r_creator","mentions":[{"paragraph":66,"text":"造物主","occurrence":0,"name":true}]},{"id":"r_original_owner","mentions":[{"paragraph":40,"text":"这副身体原来的主人","occurrence":0,"name":false}]}],"disclosures":[{"id":"d_disclaimer","from":2,"to":2,"text":"作者声明：本书出场角色均已满18岁，不存在任何未成年人。","channel":"author","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":[]},{"id":"d_name_ask","from":4,"to":4,"text":"有人询问：“姓名。”","channel":"voice","mode":"question","holder":null,"about":[]},{"id":"d_name_answer","from":5,"to":5,"text":"苏天晴说出自己的姓名：“苏天晴”。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_room_voice","from":6,"to":6,"text":"昏暗的房间里传出清脆悦耳的女声，还有一道仿佛来自遥远彼方的低沉言语。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":[]},{"id":"d_su_sees_book_mirror","from":7,"to":7,"text":"苏天晴坐在床头，看着飘浮在半空中的黑色古书，并从落地镜中瞥见一道陌生的娇小身影。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su","r_codex","r_fox_body"]},{"id":"d_fox_description","from":10,"to":11,"text":"镜中身影是一只娇小的金毛狐女，如果加上背后那只炸毛的大尾巴，像是乖巧可爱的毛茸茸金毛狐狐。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_fox_body"]},{"id":"d_book_ack","from":12,"to":12,"text":"黑色古书发出“嗯嗯……这样啊……”的回应。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_voice_pulls","from":13,"to":13,"text":"房间中的低沉言语再次响起，将苏天晴的注意力拽回黑色古书。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su","r_codex"]},{"id":"d_su_dazed","from":14,"to":14,"text":"苏天晴有些茫然。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_memory","from":15,"to":15,"text":"苏天晴回忆起五分钟前：连续三个夜班下班后，她在街边面摊吃加煎蛋的牛肉面，听到太奶在背后说话，回头看到太奶坐在藤椅上编围巾，随后胸口一疼、眼前一黑。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_su","r_grandma"]},{"id":"d_tail_touch","from":16,"to":17,"text":"苏天晴伸手在身侧炸毛大尾巴上用力薅了一把，感到无比柔顺的触感，同时从尾巴尖传来陌生的摩挲拉拽感，使狐的耳朵竖起、身体绷直。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su","r_fox_body"]},{"id":"d_real_touch","from":18,"to":18,"text":"苏天晴心想触感好真实。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_su","r_fox_body"]},{"id":"d_book_asks_why","from":19,"to":19,"text":"黑色古书问苏天晴：“……你干嘛呢。”","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_su","r_fox_body"]},{"id":"d_book_confused","from":20,"to":21,"text":"黑色古书不明白狐狐为什么突然用怪异手法薅自己的尾巴，心想不疼吗。","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_fox_body"]},{"id":"d_su_wait","from":22,"to":22,"text":"苏天晴干咳两声掩饰尴尬，阻止古书继续说：“咳咳！等一下，稍等一下！”","channel":"speech","mode":"request","holder":"r_su","about":["r_codex"]},{"id":"d_su_clears","from":23,"to":23,"text":"苏天晴掩饰尴尬，阻止古书说话，并飞快理清思绪。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su","r_codex"]},{"id":"d_su_reborn","from":24,"to":25,"text":"苏天晴意识到：我重生了，重生成了一只金毛狐女。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_su","r_fox_body"]},{"id":"d_su_question_book","from":26,"to":26,"text":"苏天晴心想，眼前这本会说话的黑色古书是怎么回事，有人能解释一下吗。","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"r_su","about":["r_su","r_codex"]},{"id":"d_su_asks_who","from":27,"to":27,"text":"苏天晴扭头正视古书，问：“你是谁？”","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_su","about":["r_codex"]},{"id":"d_book_repeats","from":28,"to":28,"text":"古书沉默了一会儿，像在思考狐狐是不是要找的人，随后重复两分钟前的开场白。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_codex","r_fox_body"]},{"id":"d_book_declares","from":29,"to":30,"text":"墨丘利秘典自称从星空彼岸远行至此，前来寻找最优秀的适格者，并说那个人就是苏天晴小姐。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_codex","r_su"]},{"id":"d_su_silent","from":31,"to":31,"text":"再次听完中二台词后，苏天晴陷入沉默与思索。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_su","r_codex"]},{"id":"d_mirror_foot","from":32,"to":33,"text":"苏天晴从床上蹦下，走到落地镜前，沉默地看向镜中穿着宽松睡裙的娇小身影，并抬脚欣赏自己的小脚。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su","r_fox_body"]},{"id":"d_foot_praise","from":34,"to":34,"text":"苏天晴心想：“嗯，完美，绝品。”","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_fox_body"]},{"id":"d_book_body_foot","from":35,"to":37,"text":"古书说看来苏天晴对现在的身体很满意，又问她为什么盯着脚看，正常情况下不应该是……","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_su","r_fox_body"]},{"id":"d_su_feet_answer","from":38,"to":38,"text":"苏天晴回答：“你不懂，小脚才是世界上最美好的瑰宝，吃饭的时候看见了都能多炫两碗。”","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_su_conjecture_owner","from":39,"to":40,"text":"苏天晴边回答边对现状有了大概了解，并猜想这本书知道自己并不是这副身体原来的主人。","channel":"thought","mode":"conjecture","holder":"r_su","about":["r_su","r_codex","r_original_owner"]},{"id":"d_book_next_step","from":41,"to":41,"text":"古书说：“既然你这么满意，那咱们可以直接快进到下个步骤了。”","channel":"speech","mode":"plan","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_su","r_fox_body"]},{"id":"d_book_pulls_back","from":42,"to":42,"text":"古书将苏天晴从欣赏狐狐身躯中唤回，她转身正视着它。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su","r_codex","r_fox_body"]},{"id":"d_book_contract_offer","from":43,"to":44,"text":"墨丘利秘典对苏天晴说，她是其最佳适格者，作为星界使者会引导她走上完美生活，她只需与其签订一个小小的契约。","channel":"speech","mode":"promise","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_codex","r_su"]},{"id":"d_su_sign","from":45,"to":45,"text":"苏天晴回答：“好，我签。”","channel":"speech","mode":"promise","holder":"r_su","about":["r_codex"]},{"id":"d_book_flustered","from":46,"to":48,"text":"古书惊讶苏天晴不按套路出牌，问她怎么契约说签就签、都不犹豫考虑一下。","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_su_narrow_wishes","from":49,"to":50,"text":"苏天晴严肃地说古书思想狭隘，并问世界上最通用的愿望是哪两个。","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_su","about":["r_codex","r_su"]},{"id":"d_book_which_two","from":51,"to":51,"text":"古书愣愣地反问：“……哪两个？”","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_su_wishes_fox","from":52,"to":55,"text":"苏天晴晃动两根手指，宣称取之不尽的财富和变成萝莉是世界上最通用的两个愿望，又说变成萝莉本身就是最大奖励，何况还是这样一只可爱的狐狐。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_su","r_fox_body"]},{"id":"d_book_contract_confirm_ask","from":56,"to":58,"text":"沉默后，古书把话题拖回正题，问既然苏天晴答应，契约是否就算成立。","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_su","r_codex"]},{"id":"d_su_confirm","from":59,"to":59,"text":"苏天晴不假思索地回答：“成立。”","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_codex"]},{"id":"d_su_ask_contract","from":60,"to":61,"text":"狐狐反应过来后好奇地问，能否问问契约的具体内容。","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_su","about":["r_codex"]},{"id":"d_su_slave_worry","from":62,"to":62,"text":"苏天晴心想，总不能是激活了什么奇怪的奴隶契约，那样可就亏大了。","channel":"thought","mode":"conjecture","holder":"r_su","about":["r_su","r_codex"]},{"id":"d_book_villain_magical_girl","from":63,"to":64,"text":"古书没有丝毫停顿地回答契约内容是：“反派魔法少女。”","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_su_ah","from":65,"to":65,"text":"苏天晴发出：“啊？”","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_su","about":[]},{"id":"d_book_task_creator","from":66,"to":66,"text":"古书说契约已签订，从今天起苏天晴将成为魔法少女活跃于世，造物主为她量身定制了一整套任务，能帮助她逐步走上反派魔法少女的顶点。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_su","r_codex","r_creator"]},{"id":"d_su_death_rate","from":67,"to":67,"text":"苏天晴问魔法少女是怎么回事，是不是死亡率高达90%的高危职业。","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_su","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_book_wangdao","from":68,"to":68,"text":"古书回答：“放心吧，是王道系的那种。”","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_su_villain_death","from":69,"to":69,"text":"苏天晴说在王道故事里当反派是纯纯的找死。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_su_regret","from":70,"to":72,"text":"苏天晴突然有点后悔，心想王道系是魔法少女成长后喊着友情和羁绊把反派干碎的故事，反派很难赢，并自问能否反悔、能否被送回原来的身体，觉得急性心肌梗死还有抢救机会。","channel":"thought","mode":"conjecture","holder":"r_su","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d_system_bind","from":73,"to":73,"text":"墨丘利秘典绑定成功。","channel":"in-world-system","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_codex","r_su"]},{"id":"d_voice_cry","from":74,"to":74,"text":"脑子里响起的声音让苏天晴欲哭无泪。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su","r_codex"]},{"id":"d_system_contract","from":75,"to":75,"text":"契约成立。","channel":"in-world-system","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_codex","r_su"]},{"id":"d_system_path","from":76,"to":76,"text":"走上反派魔法少女的道路吧，苏天晴。","channel":"in-world-system","mode":"request","holder":"r_codex","about":["r_codex","r_su"]}],"beats":[{"id":"b_title","from":1,"to":1,"gist":"标题：第1章
